name: Elevator & Fire Service Keys
description: Fire service elevator keys are standardized by jurisdiction and allow operation of elevators in emergency mode, bypassing normal call controls. In many buildings these same keys also access fire alarm panels, sprinkler rooms, and other life-safety infrastructure. The Sparrows Elevator Key Set covers the most common fire service key profiles in use across North America.

blue.det: Individual using fire service key outside emergency context; elevator in service mode without maintenance visit scheduled.
blue.cm: Log all fire service key use; coordinate with building management on scheduled maintenance; camera coverage of elevator service panels; physical key audit.
